description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the generated token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

description.zh: 实例ID，您可调用DescribeDBInstances接口获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the instance. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the ID of the instance.

description.zh:
数据库类型。

> 该参数当前仅支持传入MySQL值。
description.en:
The engine of the database.

> Only MySQL is supported.
The password that is used to access the database.

description.zh: 地域ID，您可调用DescribeDBInstanceAttribute接口查看实例所在地域ID。
description.en: The region ID of the instance. You can call the DescribeDBInstanceAttribute operation to query the region ID of the instance.

description.zh: 实例所在的资源组ID，您可调用DescribeDBInstanceAttribute接口获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs. You can call the DescribeDBInstanceAttribute operation to query the ID of the resource group.
The username that is used to access the database.
